notes: Hostile Robloxians that shoot back make this the PvE Shooter row rather than the Aim Trainer range the word 'targets' first suggests, and it is Shooter rather than Simulation because the shooting is the game — the money is a gun shop, not a stat whose number going up is the point. The preset's lane-network is swapped for open-battlefield, since a thousand-by-thousand-stud no-man's-land is one large contiguous map of dispersed positions rather than parallel lanes; spawner-npc gives the hostiles a readable direction to come from, choke-bottleneck survives as the trench and crater pinches that terrain implies, and station-loadout is where money is spent on better guns. The preset's building-interior is dropped because nothing says players go inside, which keeps the whole build on P0. Decided without a user: play runs continuously with no timer or damage target per the answer, so no finish geometry is placed, and the stated 1000x1000 studs is the playable area with any border sitting at or outside its edge.
